'''Solgaleo''' (Japanese: '''ソルガレオ''' ''Solgaleo'') is a member of the [[light trio]] and the second to appear, being seen as a {{p|Cosmog}}. It later evolved into {{p|Cosmoem}} and then into {{p|Solgaleo}}.

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}}===
Two {{p|Cosmog}} were obtained by the [[Aether Foundation]] for the purpose of opening [[Ultra Wormhole]]s: one of them was stolen by [[Lillie]] and [[nickname]]d [[Nebby]], while the other was given to [[Guzma]] to open Ultra Wormholes and summon [[Ultra Beast]]s.

Cosmog first appeared in ''[[PASM18|Confusion and Monsters from Another World]]'', where Guzma used the [[Pokémon category|Nebula Pokémon]] to open multiple Ultra Wormholes and summon Ultra Beasts to attack the [[Trial Captain]]s who came to negotiate with [[Team Skull]] at [[Po Town]]. [[PASM19|During]] the battle, a {{p|Nihilego}} dragged Guzma into one of the Ultra Wormhole, separating him from Cosmog.

In ''[[PASM23|Battle in Vast Poni Canyon]]'', it was revealed that Cosmog had [[evolved]] into a {{p|Cosmoem}} and was picked up by [[Plumeria]]. Plumeria tried using it to force [[Faba]] to tell her where Guzma was taken to. Before she could get her answers, it flew out of her hands and met with Nebby in the skies above [[Poni Island]]. Upon [[PASM24|arriving]], the [[guardian deities]] took {{adv|Sun}} and {{adv|Moon}} and placed them on the [[Poni Altar]] with the [[Sun Flute|Sun]] and [[Moon Flute]]s. By playing the flutes together, Sun and Moon caused the Altar to react and release a light that hit both Cosmoem.

The light caused Cosmoem and Nebby to evolve into {{p|Solgaleo}} and {{p|Lunala}}, respectively. With its newly-gained power, Solgaleo attempted to link its aura with Sun's to fend off the Ultra Beasts that had arrived to attack the Poni Altar, but Sun rejected the Sunne Pokémon to instead focus on Faba. Shortly after, a larger than usual Ultra Wormhole appeared at the Altar with a {{p|Necrozma}}'s hand emerging from it. The hand took control of Solgaleo's body. The possessed Solgaleo grabbed Sun with its tail and jumped into the wormhole.

After being taken into the Ultra Wormhole, Solgaleo was fused with Necrozma to become {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Necrozma|Dusk Mane Necrozma}}. Necrozma then traveled to [[Ultra Megalopolis]], where it attempted to absorb energy from Solgaleo to regain its true strength on top of the [[Megalo Tower]]. [[PASM28|Six months later]], Lunala arrived in Ultra Megalopolis with Sun and Moon and battled a {{p|Stakataka}} that had entered the city. The battle alerted Necrozma, who released Solgaleo and leapt from the Megalo Tower to try and absorb Lunala as well.

In ''[[PASM36|Regeneration!! The Power of the Sun and the Moon!]]'', Solgaleo absorbed the energy from the sun in [[Alola]] that came through the Ultra Wormhole that Necrozma had created. It jumped through the Wormhole and appeared at [[Mount Lanakila]], where it teamed up with Sun to fight {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Necrozma|Ultra Necrozma}}. Linking with his aura, Solgaleo attacked the Prism Pokémon with multiple {{m|Sunsteel Strike}}s, but was quickly overpowered. When Necrozma was about to finish off Sun and Solgaleo, {{adv|Zygarde}} attacked the Prism Pokémon. Shortly after, Moon arrived and gave Solgaleo a [[Max Revive]] while her {{TP|Moon|Decidueye}} stopped Necrozma's movements with {{m|Spirit Shackle}}. With Necrozma's movements stopped, Solgaleo teamed up with Lunala and Zygarde and defeated the Prism Pokémon.

Several months later, Solgaleo took [[Gladion]] and [[Dulse]] into [[Ultra Space]] to look for Faba.

==Personality and characteristics==
As a Cosmog, Solgaleo was often seen with an angry expression on its face. It had no problem opening [[Ultra Wormhole]]s and did so many times without hesitation. After its [[Evolution]] into Solgaleo, it took a more active role in trying to protect [[Alola]], as evident by its desire to fight off the [[Ultra Beast]]s attacking it.
